title: Android 10 (LOS17) no connection to transmitter: "No valid timestamp stored for transmitter: 8K****"
symptom: After attempting to extend sensor life by stopping the sensor after disabling Bluetooth, the OB Collector fails to bond with the transmitter, logging 'No valid timestamp stored for transmitter: 8K****' and showing 'Scanning Errors' every 5 minutes. Restarting collector, rebooting phone, forgetting transmitter, and reinstalling xDrip+ did not fix it.
cause: The invalid timestamp log is a symptom of not having proper connectivity established between the device and the transmitter, requiring correction of xDrip settings. The thread also suggests that stopping the sensor after disabling Bluetooth may have caused the transmitter to stop working.
fix: One user resolved it by starting a new sensor through a modified version of the official Dexcom app (remove xDrip+ first), then deinstalling that app and reinstalling xDrip+. Another maintainer suggests correcting xDrip settings and provides links to Facebook group and Gitter for detailed instructions.
evidence_quote: The invalid timestap log is a symptom of not having proper connectivity established between the device and the transmitter. It requires correcting the xDrip settings.
